notes.U+1E00: A + ring below (our rough O, complete with its counter, thickened back)
notes.U+1E01: a + ring below (our rough O, complete with its counter, thickened back)
notes.U+1E98: w + ring above (our rough O, complete with its counter, thickened back)
notes.U+1E99: y + ring above (our rough O, complete with its counter, thickened back)
notes.U+1E9A: a + right half ring (right half of our ring, round ends) at the upper right; advance widened to hold it
notes.U+1E9B: long s with its crossbar band replaced by the stem below it (clearly f without crossbar) + dot above (full size)
notes.U+20AB: d + bar through the ascender + underline (bars = our minus sign, 54 units)
notes.U+20AE: T + bar across the stem 40% below the top bar
notes.U+20B8: T + second bar just under the top bar
notes.U+20BD: P + one bar across the stem under the bowl
notes.U+20B1: P + two bars across stem and bowl
notes.U+20B3: A + bar across both legs, low
notes.U+20BF: B + two short vertical strokes above and below (minus sign turned 90 deg, weight 0.6 x stem)
notes.U+20A0: C + our E at 66% (re-thickened) overlapping the lower arm of the C; advance = C + E - overlap
